definition: Christopher Ré is an American computer scientist.
details: Pioneered weak supervision (Snorkel), data-centric AI, and hardware-aware sub-quadratic architectures (FlashAttention, Hyena, Mamba). He is currently employed by Stanford University, where he is a full professor. He was awarded a MacArthur Fellowship in 2015. Ré specializes in big data analysis. He co-founded Lattice.io, a data mining and machine learning company that was acquired by Apple in May 2017. == References ==

explainer.lead: Christopher Ré is an American computer scientist. His work spans computer science, informatics, big data and data mining.
